static_traits.name: Lin Ruoqing
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, with a French bulldog
static_traits.social_status: Has a few colleagues to talk to, but because of performance worries often finds it hard to open up, and relationship maintenance is affected
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior counseling/treatment history; no similar psychological issues before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic; slightly nervous at the start but cooperative; able to notice and describe anxiety and stress, willing to make plans together with the counselor

basic_info.main_problem: Strong feelings of failure and anxiety from the performance pressure of needing to sell at least 10 washing machines daily at work, recently worsening and affecting sleep, diet, and colleague relationships.
basic_info.core_demands: Fear of failure and ongoing stress at work have affected my mental health and overall well-being; hoping to relieve this stress and anxiety.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on work performance

special_situations.event: On workdays faces the company's performance target of 'selling at least 10 washing machines per day'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not sell 10 units that day, it equals failure, meaning I am no good and the future will be affected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets reminders, watches motivational videos, does relaxation exercises and forces themselves to push through in pursuit of meeting standards
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I do not reach 10 units today, I am just a failure, and may have to give up my dream of becoming a journalist

special_situations.event: After not yet meeting a sales target one day, thinking about the manager's view of her performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not met the target, the manager will surely be disappointed and I will eventually lose my job
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing in-depth communication with colleagues, bearing anxiety alone to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He will be disappointed in me; I might get fired

special_situations.event: Even after reaching the day's goal, when facing sales targets again the next day
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Must meet the standard every day to count as qualified; otherwise a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly reminding herself and setting higher standards to maintain performance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: A single day of missing the target proves I am no good

special_situations.event: When interacting with colleagues at work and thinking she may not reach the target
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I perform poorly, others will look down on me, so saying less and erring less is safer
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids in-depth communication; shortens conversations with colleagues
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My poor performance makes everyone reluctant to approach me

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and seen as competent, and to gain safety and stability (keep the job and be able to keep pursuing the dream of becoming a journalist)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure being negated, being blamed, worrying about losing work and dreams
defense_goal: Uses high standards and self-pressure to avoid failure and being blamed
Reduces emotional contact with colleagues to lower the risk of being evaluated
Suppressing unease and shame through rational analysis and self-persuasion

object_relations.self_representation: Seeing herself as a 'failure / unqualified employee' when missing targets
object_relations.object_representation: Others (especially superiors) experienced as harsh, disappointed judges

object_relations.self_representation: A person who seems anxious and distant in colleague relationships
object_relations.object_representation: Colleagues experienced as people who may look down on me and find it hard to understand me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to examine the 'evidence' and challenge the belief 'failure = low self-worth'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Admitting missing targets equals admitting being utterly worthless, inviting negation
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Steady tone, emphasizing facts and logic, downplaying emotional experience as much as possible, using expressions such as 'objectively speaking...' to bypass directly feeling the sense of failure.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about the manager's/colleagues' views and evaluations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously experiencing inner self-denial as others being disappointed or looking down on her (transference: treating others as harsh judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using hypothetical and vague language (e.g. 'they might think...'), avoiding acknowledging her own unease and shame.

manifestations: Living alone, finding it hard to build and maintain relationships with colleagues
Reducing communication due to performance anxiety, finding it hard to open up to colleagues

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Taking 'selling at least 10 units a day' as the absolute standard of self-worth without digesting it
Uses must/meeting standards as the core basis of self-evaluation

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Presumes the manager will be disappointed in him and colleagues will look down on him
Experiences inner failure feelings as others' negative evaluations

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: On high-pressure days 'just gritting through it', rarely proactively seeking others' support
Turning outward anxiety and help-seeking into pressure against herself

exception_events.target_problem: On workdays facing the target of 'selling at least 10 washing machines a day', she usually develops strong anxiety and a sense of failure; after not yet meeting the target she repeatedly blames herself, affecting sleep and colleague relationships.
exception_events.unique_outcome: After reaching or exceeding the daily target on individual workdays, she felt relatively relaxed and relieved instead of persistent self-denial, and could briefly chat with colleagues.
exception_events.reason: Clue: different situation (smoother customer flow and deal rhythm that day); different approach (taking short breaks at the right time, keeping rhythm); different understanding (treating one performance as a specific event rather than an overall verdict), hence anxiety briefly dropped that day.

positive_force: On some workdays I can complete sales targets, with certain sales ability and execution capacity
Willing to seek help and work with the counselor, willing to record and identify thinking patterns
Has tried various self-help strategies (reminders, motivational videos, relaxation exercises)
Can generate more balanced alternative thoughts under guidance
negative_force: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking, equating a single performance with overall worth
Tends to predict negative outcomes and mind-read others' evaluations, overly relies on external approval
Pressuring herself and reducing interpersonal contact under stress, with insufficient use of the support system
Sleep and diet are disturbed, further weakening coping ability and work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Strong anxiety and self-denial when worrying about or not yet reaching sales targets
antecedent: On workdays, faces the performance target of 'selling at least 10 washing machines a day'
Thinking she may be unable to complete the day's target
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and the belief that ties self-worth to performance
target_behavior.function: Driving herself harder through self-pressure to avoid being judged or losing work (escaping being negated)
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent anxiety and stress cycle, sleep and eating disrupted, damaged relationships with colleagues, decline in sense of well-being

target_behavior.behavior: Reduces communication and connection with colleagues at work (avoidance)
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing negative evaluation and being negated, believing saying less and erring less is safer
target_behavior.function: Briefly escaping evaluation and interpersonal discomfort to relieve anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social support, increased sense of loneliness, anxiety maintained and affecting workplace adaptation
